name: cmd_library_autoImportScan
description: Auto Import Now (command `library.autoImportScan`). Params: {listing?: [[path, size]] (the folder as listed by the caller, e.g. on a worker thread), start?: bool (false: return the `library.import` params as `import` instead of importing)} — add the watched folder's new photos (files the library doesn't have yet; partial / still-copying files wait for the next scan) → {imported, folder, import?}.
